Traditional payment processors often impose hefty fees that can eat into profits. For instance, Gumroad charges a significant 10% on every sale, while alternative [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-what-nobody-6|solutions]] like NOWPayments charge only 0.5%. This post will guide you through using Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, ensuring you keep more of your earnings and have full control over your transactions.

That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital products typically involves using third-party platforms, which can impose high fees and restrict access. Bitcoin payments offer a decentralized alternative, allowing creators to sell directly to customers without relying on conventional payment gateways. This is particularly crucial for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where conventional options are limited or non-existent. By utilizing Bitcoin, you retain more revenue and avoid the pitfalls of traditional payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture for accepting Bitcoin payments involves several key components. You start with a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to display your products. For backend logic, you can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions and order processing. NOWPayments serves as the cryptocurrency payment gateway, handling the conversion to USD at the time of the transaction. This setup ensures that your digital products can be delivered automatically upon payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who are locked out of mainstream payment platforms due to geographical restrictions. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or software, this infrastructure empowers you to take control of your business. It appeals to those seeking low fees, flexible payment options, and the ability to operate independently of traditional financial systems. By using this architecture, creators can focus on their craft without the burden of excessive fees or unreliable payment methods.
Retain more revenue by switching from conventional payment processors.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereignty of your digital commerce stack lies in its components. You start with a free hosting solution, followed by backend scripting for processing orders. Integrating NOWPayments allows for seamless cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees. Using platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management ensures you maintain full control over your customer data. Each piece interacts to create a cohesive system that supports your business goals while minimizing costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling digital products using Bitcoin, follow these steps: First, choose a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage your product listings and orders. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, set up your delivery mechanism using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. By following this process, you can quickly deploy a fully functional online store and begin selling today.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign commerce solution that leverages Bitcoin payments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, bypassing traditional payment processors. By setting up your digital storefront using platforms like GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments, you can manage sales with minimal fees while retaining full control over your revenue.
Automate your digital product delivery with minimal effort.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to dive deeper into building a complete digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all six blueprints and seven templates. This resource equips you with everything you need to establish a sovereign digital presence. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments for my digital products?

To integrate NOWPayments, sign up for an account and obtain your API keys. Follow the integration guide to set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring it communicates with NOWPayments for transaction processing.
What platforms can I use for hosting my digital store?
You can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital store. Both options are free and allow you to showcase your products effectively without incurring additional costs.
Can I automate the delivery of my digital products?

Yes, by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, you can automate the delivery of your digital products upon successful payment confirmation. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly.
What are the benefits of using Bitcoin for payments?

Using Bitcoin allows you to accept payments without incurring high fees from traditional processors. It provides a decentralized method of transaction, ensuring that you retain control over your revenue and avoid platform restrictions.
How can I ensure my customer data is safe?

By using platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, you maintain ownership of your customer data. Ensure that your backend logic is secure and only accessible to authorized personnel.
Control your customer data and payment processes without third-party interference.
